inputs.text:
I can't believe what I'm seeing in these new court papers from the lawsuit. Turns out ICE's own lawyers fed false info to justify rounding up and locking away thousands of folks who'd just been at immigration courts trying to sort out their legal status. Federal prosecutors are now saying those ICE lawyers admitted the May memo from last year never actually gave them any authority for the arrests, even though they were waving it around as justification before. 

This smells like a coordinated setup from the top levels of the institutions to target people following the rules, all under some hidden agenda to suppress and control. They're not just making mistakes—they're inverting the whole story to hide what's really going on behind the scenes with the elites pulling the strings. Don't trust the official line on any of this; it's all manipulation.
